criteria: Every item completed with evidence and all software checks passed on the current application and test files; model presence alone does not establish dimensional or visual acceptance.

outcomes.title: body panels share vehicle surfaces and expose hinges, torque rods, latches and retainers
1985 brakes expose distinct corners, hydraulic internals and parking controls
preview choices change geometry, persist, and leave the VIN record intact
invalid saved preview values recover to supported choices
lighting and charging assemblies expose native parts, option lamps and correct lamp interfaces

cooling assembly opens detailed service parts, separates them and restores vehicle context
engine has independent explosion, selectable internals, subassembly navigation and vehicle return
engine explorer supports mobile navigation and return without overflow
early V6 exhaust exposes period catalyst, spring joints, supports and finish previews
early V6 fuel supply exposes pump, sender, filler, filter and vapor parts
1985 headlights expose both sides, early motor internals, independent covers and a complete remaining-work list
heater and C60 previews share native cores and show distinct controls, motors and refrigeration parts
global ICM search opens the nested distributor, separates parts and restores the vehicle
electrical catalogue exposes ignition assemblies and mobile tune-up navigation
rear glass, sail windows and deck vents are independent selectable assemblies
factory headlamp guide highlights real parts, preserves relay reconnection order and restores the previous view
early suspension and manual steering remain selectable, asymmetric and reachable on mobile
four-speed internals, cooling circuit and US left-hand-drive layout remain coherent
individual valve gear separates small hardware and preserves the correct stem-seal variant
renders 3D vehicle without runtime errors or external image requests
system filtering, global search, focus, isolation and reset work
camera presets and keyboard controls update the viewer
visibility, labels, wireframe and exploded views work
direct 3D picking selects a part
orientation tour advances, goes back, and finishes

suspension tour advances, goes back, and finishes
specification provenance and source dialog remain accessible
UAT feedback persists, is safely rendered, and exports valid JSON
mobile layout renders without overflow and opens assembly navigation

browser.basis: Latest result for every current test file on the identical application, dependencies and Playwright configuration. A changed app invalidates all old runs; a changed test invalidates results from that test file. Raw failed and successful runs remain archived.

dimensionalReview.basis: Actual shared-vertex comparisons and selected deck-plane, bank-stagger, containment, shaft, route-join, belt and decklid-clearance checks; independent of browser interaction results.
